bandReport.notes:
All 15 questions 71-85 are present, complete and self-contained within pages 13-15; no stem or option block starts mid-sentence and none spills overleaf. Q71 opens page 13 cleanly at the top of the left column; Q85's option block ends above the footer of page 15 with whitespace after it. Nothing from a neighbouring band is visible on these pages - page 13 starts at Q71 and page 15 ends at Q85.

Page 13 is the only two-column trap in the band: Q72's stem and its three statements sit in the left column, but its 'Select the correct answer using the code given below.' line and its four code options (1 and 3 only / 1, 2 and 3 / 1 and 2 only / 3 only) are printed at the FOOT of the left column, level with Q75's four name options in the right column. The OCR text layer interleaves the two option blocks line by line; the page image was used to keep each option block with its own question, and each was re-checked label-by-label afterwards.

OCR-vs-image disagreements, all resolved in favour of the image and all OCR artifacts rather than page defects: Q71(a) OCR reads '91 St Amendment', the page prints '91st Amendment' (confirmed at 5x); Q75 stem OCR reads 'Montresd', the page prints 'Montreal'; Q75(d) OCR reads 'SEimvida Nanda', the page prints 'Samvida Nanda' (both confirmed at 5x); Q81(c) OCR reads 'Tavemier', the page prints 'Tavernier'.

One de-hyphenation decision: Q80(a) breaks 'self-annihilation' across a line as 'self-' / 'annihilation'; transcribed as the single hyphenated word (confirmed at 5x - the hyphen is a line-break hyphen inside one word, not a separator).

Scan speckle only, not content, and not transcribed: a stray tick before '(d)' in Q74, a stray dot in the left margin of Q80(a), and a stray tick inside 'Lieutenant Commander' in Q84(d) (justification spacing, not a character).

Every option block was re-checked label-by-label against the page after transcription, and then independently against the PDF's OCR text stream by script. That script raised 6 anomalies, all confirmed as OCR or probe artifacts rather than transcription errors: the four OCR misreads listed above, the Q80(a) hyphen wrap, and one false 'out of order' on Q72(d) where '3 only' is a substring of the earlier option '1 and 3 only'.
